root_idea.summary: The lexical family centers on openness, spaciousness, and emergence into an open domain, with derived uses of reaching, contact, intimacy, and disclosure.
root_idea.development: The evidence moves from becoming wide, open, or vacant to coming into another's space; Form IV extends this orientation to reaching, intimate approach, physical contact, communication, and related specialized uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form IV verb with a normalized perfect-tense dictionary headword.

senses.definition: To come to, reach, or become closely joined to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Constructed with إِلَى; in the Quranic reciprocal construction, it denotes one person coming to or reaching the other and becoming alone or closely joined.

senses.definition: To approach sexually; to have sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: An intimate euphemistic use of أَفْضَى إِلَى, including the reciprocal construction in which one person comes into intimate union with another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become wide or spacious; also to become empty, vacant, or void.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb of becoming open or unoccupied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of trees, to become numerous or abundant in a place, occupying it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use describing vegetation spreading through a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave money strewn rather than put away in a purse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction فَضَا دَرَاهِمَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth or come to an open space.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV directional use with فَضَاءٌ as the destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring or lead someone to a wide or spacious place; of a road, to lead to a rugged tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with بِـ in constructions of bringing or leading to a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To touch or place the hand against something without an intervening barrier.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One attested application is touching the ground with the palm during prostration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To communicate or disclose a secret to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with بِـ in the construction of acquainting another person with a secret.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become poor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or assumed-tropical use, explained as coming down to the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make the mouth wide and empty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a traditional prayer phrase concerning the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the central incisors, to fall out; or to cause them to be lost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported specialized usage concerning the upper and lower central incisors.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a woman's vaginal and rectal passages one by rupture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical use associated with defloration or sexual intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose vaginal and rectal passages have been made one by rupture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical epithet corresponding to the preceding verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mixed together, scattered, or left in a disorderly state; of goods, held in common.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food, dates, goods, affairs, or belongings that are mixed, promiscuous, or unmanaged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One or single; alone or apart from others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word has opposed applications in the evidence, including singularity and being left without one's fellows or family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The stones or seeds of raisins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical application, also associated in the evidence with a variant spelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water that collects and stagnates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its reported plural is فِضَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Width or spaciousness; an open court, yard, or wide expanse of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a verbal noun for spaciousness and substantively for an open area or plain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water running upon the surface of the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant or plural form associated with فَضْيَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide, open, plain, or vacant; in common later usage, unoccupied, unemployed, or at leisure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle used adjectivally, with a later everyday sense of having no occupation or engagement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of spaciousness or a wide open place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting a spacious location.

cautions: The Form IV construction أَفْضَى إِلَى in 4:21 has overlapping traditional interpretations, from coming to or reaching another to intimate privacy and sexual intercourse; these related but materially distinct uses are kept separate.
